questions.q: Anuja owns $66 \frac{2}{3}\%$ of a property. If $30\%$ of the property that she owns is worth $1,25,000$, then $45\%$ of the value (in Rs) of the property is:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, seedha fraction se fodenge. $66 \frac{2}{3}\% = \frac{2}{3}$ aur $30\% = \frac{3}{10}$. Toh total property ka $\frac{2}{3} \times \frac{3}{10} = \frac{1}{5}$ hissa $1,25,000$ hai. Hamein $45\%$ yani $\frac{9}{20}$ hissa chahiye. Agar $\frac{1}{5}$ (yani $\frac{4}{20}$) ki value $1,25,000$ hai, toh $\frac{9}{20}$ ki kya hogi? $\frac{9}{4} \times 1,25,000 = 9 \times 31250 = 2,81,250$. Fraction logic is much faster than finding $100\%$ first!

questions.q: In a department $40\%$ of the employees are females. $60\%$ of the male employees know English. The total number of employees who know English is $66\%$. Find the percentage of females employees who know English.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ye basic weighted average ya tree method ka sawal hai. Total $100$ maan le. Females $40$, toh Males $60$. Males jo English jante hain = $60\%$ of $60 = 36$. Total English wale $66$ hain, toh Females kitni bachi? $66 - 36 = 30$. Ab ye $30$ total females ($40$) ka kitna percent hai? $\frac{30}{40} \times 100 = 75\%$. Simple subtraction aur percentage, free ke $2$ number!

questions.q: If a price is reduced by $10\%$ and then again reduced by $20\%$, what is the overall percentage decrease? (PHASE XIII(HS) - 26/07/2025-SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, jab lagatar decrease ho toh Successive ka formula $x + y - \frac{xy}{100}$ lagate hain. $10 + 20 - \frac{200}{100} = 28\%$.

CaseFormula
1. Both Increase$x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$
2. Both Decrease$x + y - \frac{xy}{100}$ (Net Decrease)

questions.q: A number is first increased by $12.5\%$ and then decreased by $25\%$. The number so obtained is now increased by $20\%$. What is the net increase or decrease percentage in the original number?
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Ratio method se best hoga kyunki fractions standard hain. $12.5\% = +\frac{1}{8}$ (yani $8 \to 9$), $25\% = -\frac{1}{4}$ (yani $4 \to 3$), $20\% = +\frac{1}{5}$ (yani $5 \to 6$). Multiply maar: $8 \times 4 \times 5 = 160$ aur $9 \times 3 \times 6 = 162$. Initial $160$ se final $162$ hua, matlab $+2$ ka change $160$ par. $\frac{2}{160} = \frac{1}{80} = 1.25\%$ ka net increase. Exact fractions yaad hone chahiye boss!

questions.q: If the price of a product increases by $25\%$, by what percent should the consumption be reduced to keep the expenditure same? (CHSL TIER I - 28/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, isme AB Rule zindabad! Agar Price $\frac{1}{4}$ se badha hai ($+25\%$), toh Expenditure constant rakhne ke liye Consumption hamesha $\frac{1}{4+1} = \frac{1}{5}$ se ghatega. Aur $\frac{1}{5}$ matlab $20\%$ hota hai. Pen uthane ki bhi zarurat nahi thi!

questions.q: The price of an article is reduced by $25\%$ but the daily sale of the article is increased by $30\%$. The net effect on the daily sale receipts is?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, receipt directly Price $\times$ Sale par depend karti hai. Aise questions me direct successive lagao: $x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$. Yahan $-25 + 30 - \frac{25 \times 30}{100} = 5 - 7.5 = -2.5\%$. Minus sign ka matlab Decrease. Aise lallu questions ko secondon mein udana hai CGL me!

questions.q: In an election between two candidates, $5\%$ of the registered voters did not cast their vote. $10\%$ of the total votes polled were found to be either invalid or of NOTA. The winning candidate received $60\%$ votes in his favor and won the election by $17,271$ votes. Find the number of registered voters.
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Ek line me equation likh: $\text{Total} \times \frac{19}{20} \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{20}{100} = 17271$. Left side me $19 \times 9 = 171$ ban raha hai. Aur numerator mein samne $17271$ hai, saf saf dikh raha hai ki $171 \times 101 = 17271$ hota hai. Seedha $\text{Total} = 1,01,000$. Digital Sum bhi laga sakte the, par direct divisibility jyada tez hai yahan.

questions.q: The monthly salary of a person was $\text{Rs. } 1,60,000$. He used to spend on three heads - Personal and family expenses (P), Taxes (T) and Education loan (E). The rest were his savings. P was $50\%$ of the income, E was $20\%$ of P, and T was $15\%$ of E. When his salary got raised by $30\%$, he maintained the percentage level of P, but E became $30\%$ of P and T became $20\%$ of E. The sum of the two savings (in Rs.) is:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, question lamba zaroor hai par basic percentage ka hai. P, E, aur T ka structure bana le. Pehli condition me Total Exp: $50\% + 20\%(50\%) + 15\%(10\%) = 50\% + 10\% + 1.5\% = 61.5\%$ of Income. Toh S1 = $38.5\%$ of $1,60,000 = 61,600$. Dusri baar naya Income $2,08,000$ hai. Exp = $50\% + 30\%(50\%) + 20\%(15\%) = 50\% + 15\% + 3\% = 68\%$. Toh S2 = $32\%$ of $2,08,000 = 66,560$. Dono ka sum $= 1,28,160$. Base values sahi rakhoge toh calculation me galti nahi hogi.

questions.q: A student scores $75\%$ marks in an exam. If he scored 450 marks and the remaining $25\%$ were for practicals, what were the total marks? (PHASE XIII(GRAD) - 31/07/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Ye kya mazaak chal raha hai? $75\%$ ki fractional value $\frac{3}{4}$ hoti hai. Agar $3$ unit ki value $450$ hai, toh $1$ unit $150$ hoga. Hame total yani $4$ unit chahiye, toh $4 \times 150 = 600$. Pen bhi nahi uthana tha isme!

questions.q: A bucket is filled with water such that the weight of bucket alone is $25\%$ its weight when it is filled with water. Now some of the water is removed from the bucket and now the weight of bucket along with remaining water is $50\%$ of the original total weight. What part of the water was removed from the bucket?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, assumed values se best banega. Maan le poori bhari bucket ka weight $100$ hai. Toh khaali bucket $25$ ki hui, aur pani $75$ ka hua. Kuch pani nikala toh naya weight $50\%$ of $100 = 50$ bacha. Bucket abhi bhi $25$ ki hi hai, toh naya pani $50 - 25 = 25$ bacha. Pani tha kitna? $75$. Bacha kitna? $25$. Nikla kitna? $50$. Kispe base banega? Original pani ($75$) pe! Toh fraction aayi $\frac{50}{75} = \frac{2}{3}$. Smart work chahiye babu!

questions.q: The monthly salary of a person was $50,000$. He used to spend on Family expenses (E), Taxes (T), Charity (C), and the rest were his savings. E was $60\%$ of the income, T was $20\%$ of E, and C was $15\%$ of T. When his salary got raised by $40\%$, he maintained the percentage level of E, but T becomes $30\%$ of E and C becomes $20\%$ of T. The difference between the two savings (in Rs)?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, same pattern ka ek aur thoda calculation wala Q. Initial income $50,000$ hai. Exp % nikal: $E=60\%$, $T=20\%$ of $60\%=12\%$, $C=15\%$ of $12\%=1.8\%$. Total Exp1 $= 73.8\%$. Saving1 $= 26.2\%$ of $50k = 13,100$. Nayi income $70,000$. Naya Exp%: $E=60\%$, $T=30\%$ of $60\%=18\%$, $C=20\%$ of $18\%=3.6\%$. Total Exp2 $= 81.6\%$. Saving2 $= 18.4\%$ of $70k = 12,880$. Difference $= 13100 - 12880 = 220$. Tree bna ke calculation simple rakh!

questions.q: A man's annual income has increased by $\text{Rs. } 2$ lakhs but the tax on Income that he has to pay has reduced from $20\%$ to $16\%$. He now pays the same amount of tax as before. What is his increased income (in Rs. lakhs)?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, amount of tax same hai. Jab Amount same ho, toh Income aur Tax Rate ek dusre ke inversely proportional hote hain! Tax Rate ratio $20:16$ yani $5:4$ hai. Toh Income ratio ulat ke $4:5$ hoga. Difference kitna aaya? $1$ unit = $2$ lakh (given in Q). Pucha kya hai? Nayi (increased) income, jo $5$ unit hai. $5 \times 2 = 10$ lakh! Ekdum direct udana hai ise.

questions.q: In order to maximise his gain, a theatre owner decides to reduce the price of tickets by $15\%$ and as a result of this the sales of tickets increases by $35\%$. If as a result of this, the sales of tickets increases his weekly collection by 25200. Then find by what value did the gross collection increase per day?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ye question pura scam hai! Tumhe lag raha hoga ki pehle $14.75\%$ net change nikal kar equation solve karni padegi. Par dhyan se padh kya pucha hai: 'weekly collection increases by 25200'. Aur pucha hai 'increase per day'! Toh seedha 1 hafte ke collection increase ko 7 se divide karna tha! $25200 / 7 = 3600$. Examiner tumhare maze le raha hai, aankhein khuli rakh!

questions.q: There are two slabs of income tax, $10\%$ tax on whole income for income up to $3$ lakh and $15\%$ tax on whole income for income above $3$ lakh. Arun tried to evade tax by hiding some of the income, to fall in the $10\%$ tax slab. The amount hid by Arun is $\frac{4}{9}$ of the original taxable income. If Arun paid $\text{Rs. } 25,000$ as tax, what is the original amount of tax he had to pay?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ulta chalte hain. Arun ne $25,000$ tax bhara aur vo $10\%$ slab me aaya. Matlab usne $\text{Rs. } 2,50,000$ income declare ki. Sawal keh raha hai ki usne original ka $\frac{4}{9}$ hissa chhupaya tha, yani usne $\frac{5}{9}$ hissa declare kiya. Agar $\frac{5}{9} = 2,50,000$, toh total original income $= 4,50,000$. Niyam ke hisab se $3$ lakh se upar pe $15\%$ tax lagta hai. Toh $4,50,000$ ka $15\% = 67,500$. Language ko todna aana chahiye!

questions.q: A town has males and females in a ratio of $3:2$. After 5 years, the male population increases by $10\%$, and the female population increases by $25\%$. What is the new ratio? (CGL TIER I - 21/09/2025-SHIFT 1)
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Ratio $3:2$ ko ease ke liye $300:200$ maan le. Males badhe $10\%$, toh naye Males $= 330$. Females badhi $25\%$, toh nayi Females $= 250$. Naya ratio $330:250 = 33:25$. Basic simplification the, percentage me zero leke assume karne se galati hone ke chance zero ho jate hain.

questions.q: If a student multiplies a number by $\frac{7}{10}$ instead of $\frac{10}{7}$, then find the error percentage in the calculation?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, fractions se darne ki jarurat nahi. Base values (denominator) $10$ aur $7$ ka LCM le. Number ko $70$ maan. Sahi answer aana chahiye tha: $70 \times \frac{10}{7} = 100$. Lekin gadhe ne kiya: $70 \times \frac{7}{10} = 49$. Error kitne ka aaya? $51$ ka. Base sahi answer ($100$) hota hai, toh seedha $51\%$ error ho gaya. LCM method OP!

questions.q: If A is $50\%$ more than B, and C is $30\%$ less than the sum of A and B, then C is what percent of A? (CHSL TIER I - 18/11/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Ratio set kar. A aur B ka ratio $3:2$ hai (kyunki A $50\%$ jyada hai). Unka sum hua $5$. C is sum se $30\%$ kam hai, yani C $= 5 \times \frac{7}{10} = 3.5$. Pucha hai C, A ka kitna percent hai: $\frac{3.5}{3} \times 100 = \frac{350}{3} = 116.67\%$. Decimal fractions strong rakh apne!

questions.q: Sum of A and B is $100\%$ more than the sum of C and D. C is $20\%$ more than D. If A is $200\%$ more than B and D=500, then what is the value of A? (CHSL TIER I - 24/11/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, step by step kholte ja isko. D = $500$ diya hai. C, $20\%$ jyada hai $\implies C = 600$. C+D milkar $1100$ hue. Ab A+B inka $100\%$ jyada (yani double) hai, toh A+B = $2200$ ho gaya. A, B se $200\%$ jyada hai, iska matlab A aur B ka ratio $3:1$ hai. $4$ unit ki value $2200$ hai, toh $1$ unit $550$ nikli. A ki value ($3$ unit) nikalne ke liye $550 \times 3 = 1650$. Link jodte jao, answer nikalta jayega!

questions.q: A student gets 66 marks more in French than what she got in German. Her German marks are $28\%$ of the sum of her French and German marks. What are her French marks?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, percentage ko fraction me convert kar. $28\% = \frac{7}{25}$. Agar F+G = $25$ hai, toh G ke marks $7$ hue. Bacha F, jiske marks $25 - 7 = 18$ honge. Ratio $F:G = 18:7$ aa gaya. Inka difference $11$ unit hai, jiske barabar sawal me $66$ marks diye hain ($1$ unit = $6$). Toh French ke marks ($18$ unit) honge: $18 \times 6 = 108$. Direct Unit Digit se bhi dekh sakte ho $8 \times 6$ end me $8$ aayega!

questions.q: In an exam, (x+50)% of the students passed in English, (x+30)% of the students passed in Science and x% of the students passed in both subjects. If $15\%$ of the students failed in both subjects, then find the value of x.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Venn diagram ki equation lagani hai. Agar $15\%$ dono me fail hue, toh kisi na kisi me pass hone wale log $100\% - 15\% = 85\%$ hue. Formula lagao: Total Pass = Pass in Eng + Pass in Sci - Pass in Both. Yani $85 = (x+50) + (x+30) - x$. Solve karke $x+80 = 85$ aayega. Seedha $x=5$. Options dekho aur tik karo!

questions.q: The area of a regular triangle increases by $44\%$. By what percentage did the side length increase? (CGL TIER I - 22/09/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, area humesha 2D hota hai (side $\times$ side), isliye $A \propto a^2$. Agar area me $44\%$ ka increase hai, yani wo $100$ se $144$ ho gaya. Side pe aane ke liye iska square root nikal lo. $\sqrt{100}$ se $\sqrt{144}$ $\implies$ $10$ se $12$ ban gaya. Yani har $10$ pe $2$ ka increase, matlab base $100$ pe $20\%$ ki badhotari.

DimensionRelation
1. Length/Radius$x$ (1D)
2. Area$x^2$ (2D)
3. Volume$x^3$ (3D)

questions.q: If a% of 240 is c and c% of a is 117.6, then the value of a+c is:
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Equations set kar. $\frac{a \times 240}{100} = c \implies c = 2.4a$. Dusri equation: $\frac{a \times c}{100} = 117.6 \implies ac = 11760$. Yahan par $c$ ki value rakh de toh $2.4a^2 = 11760$ banega. Is se $a^2 = 4900$ aayega, toh $a = 70$. $a$ ki value se $c = 168$ aa jayega. Pucha $a+c$ hai toh $70 + 168 = 238$. Approximation yahan fail ho sakti thi par Digital sum se check kar sakte ho!

questions.q: If each side of a square is increased by $50\%$ then what is the percentage change in its area?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Successive percentage ka sabse standard question. $x+y+\frac{xy}{100}$ laga aur answer nikal. $50 + 50 + \frac{2500}{100} = 125\%$. Ya ratio se $2 \to 3$ hua. Area $4 \to 9$ ho gaya. Increment aaya $5$ ka $4$ par, $\frac{5}{4} \times 100 = 125\%$. Free ka number hai ye!

questions.q: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town whose current population of $2,60,000$ is increasing at a rate of $25\%$ every year?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, line by line reverse me chal. Har saal $25\%$ yani $\frac{1}{4}$ badhti hai, toh nayi population purani ka $\frac{5}{4}$ hoti hai. $3$ saal pehle agar $P_3$ thi, toh $P_3 \times \frac{125}{64} = 2,60,000$ hogi jisse $P_3 = 1,33,120$ ayega. Waise hi $2$ saal pehle $P_2 = P_3 \times 1.25 = 1,66,400$. Dono ka difference pucha hai $1,66,400 - 1,33,120 = 33,280$. Ya direct difference $P_3$ ka $25\%$ yani $\frac{1}{4}$ of $1,33,120 = 33,280$. Ekdum tez nikalta hai aise!

questions.q: A reduction of $10\%$ in the price of sugar enables a housewife to buy 6.2 kg more for 1116. The reduced price per kg is?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, super trick batata hu iski! Jab amount fix ho ($\text{Rs. } 1116$), toh direct saved paisa nikal liya kar. $1116$ ka $10\%$ discount mila, yani $\text{Rs. } 111.6$ bache! Is bache paise mein usko $6.2$ kg sugar extra mil gayi. Toh naya (reduced) price hua $\frac{111.6}{6.2} = \text{Rs. } 18$ per kg. Exam me is se jaldi aur kuch nahi ho sakta!
